purpose: Non-production demo seed for VieMo social discovery, profiles, collections, watch history, and reviews
disclaimer: ALL people, profiles, user ratings and reviews in this file are synthetic DEMO data. Do not pass them off as real users or organic community activity. Do not run against production without explicit approval.
movie_identity: Resolve title + release_year against the actual TMDB API and persist verified TMDB IDs; reject ambiguous or unmatched results.
seed_execution: Use a server-only Supabase Auth admin client to create linked demo users. No passwords are in this fixture. Seed idempotently by seed_key and limit cleanup to those records. Inspect existing schema and respect RLS, privacy, and Auth triggers.
